reason: I'd use the free first visit on a Saturday and probably pay for one more weekend drop-in if my kid liked it. We'd go once or twice a month at most, so no membership for me.
objection: We'd only go once or twice a month, so unlimited never pays off and $15 a visit adds up fast on top of everything else we do on Saturdays.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper weekend drop-in rate, around $10 to $11, would make me go more often.
